page_no_similar: No note is close to this one.
page_empty_day: Nothing captured. Press {hotkey} to write a note.
page_delete_description: It is removed from its day file. There is no undo.
capture_hint: Ctrl+Enter to save, Ctrl+Shift+Enter for a page, Esc to dismiss
capture_space_title: The space the note goes into. {first} to {last} pick one.
update_hint: {version} is out; you have {current}. Updating restarts Scratchnote.
status_loading_hint: Loading the model into memory. The first note after launch or after an idle unload waits for this, then labelling starts.
status_enriching_hint: The model is writing a subject and a category for new or edited notes, one at a time, in the background.
status_enriching_progress_hint: The model is writing a subject and a category for note {current} of {total}, one at a time, in the background.
status_absent_hint: Notes are saved but not labelled until a model is installed. Pick one in Settings.
status_downloading_hint: The model is downloading. Notes captured meanwhile are queued and labelled once it is ready.
status_idle_hint: The model was unloaded after sitting idle, to free memory. It loads again with the next note.
status_ready_hint: The model is in memory with nothing left to do. New and edited notes are labelled within seconds.
status_disabled_hint: The model is turned off in Settings. Notes are saved and searchable, and wait to be labelled until it is back on. Chat is unavailable.
model_default_note: Qwen3 4B. Better labels, wants more RAM.
model_light_note: Qwen3 1.7B. Quicker, kinder to a small machine.
onboarding_downloading_body: Capture keeps working. Notes stay pending until this finishes.
onboarding_absent_body: Notes are saved and searchable without one. A model adds a subject and a category.
onboarding_language_body: Scratchnote and the labels it writes on your notes follow this language. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding_welcome_body: A scratchpad for the thoughts that come up in the middle of a task. Jot one down, get back to work, and find it again later.
onboarding_local_body: Your notes, their labels, search and chat all run here: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Nothing you write ever leaves this machine. The only thing Scratchnote downloads is the model itself, once, when you ask for it.
onboarding_feature_capture_body: A shortcut opens a small window over whatever you are doing. Type, save, and it is out of the way.
onboarding_feature_labels_body: A language model gives each note a subject and a category, in the background.
onboarding_feature_chat_body: Search by word or by meaning, or chat with your notes to find what you wrote.
onboarding_feature_spaces_body: Work, side projects, personal: each space has its own notes and chat, in its own folder.
onboarding_folder_body: Each space gets its own folder in here, with one markdown file per day that any editor can open. The models are kept here too, and nothing is synced anywhere.
onboarding_folder_restart: Scratchnote restarts to use this folder, then picks up where you left off.
onboarding_hotkey_body: Press it from any app to open the capture window. To change it, click the field and press a new combination.
onboarding_hotkey_try: Try it now: the capture window opens over this one.
onboarding_machine_body: Scratchnote looks at what this computer can run to suggest the model that fits it best.
onboarding_machine_no_gpu: None the model can use, so it runs on the processor
onboarding_machine_reason_gpu: Your graphics card has room for it, so labels come out both good and quick.
onboarding_machine_reason_cpu: There is no graphics card to lean on, but enough memory and cores to run it on the processor.
onboarding_machine_reason_small: It labels notes quickly on this machine without taking over its memory.
onboarding_machine_estimate: An estimate from the hardware. Once a model is in, the speed test in Settings times it for real.
onboarding_model_body: It runs entirely on this computer, so your notes never leave it. It is downloaded once, and the search model ({size}) comes along to find notes by meaning.
onboarding_model_background: You can carry on: downloads continue in the background.
onboarding_appearance_body: Pick a theme, an accent and a font. Every choice applies at once, and Settings has them all later.
note_edit_hint: Ctrl+Enter to save, Esc to cancel
search_chat_title: Chat with the model about this space. It reads the space index: dates, subjects and categories, and with the embedding model the text of the notes closest to your question.
search_chat_disabled: Chatting needs a model. Pick one in Settings.
chat_intro: Ask anything about the notes in {space}. The model reads this space's index: each note's date, subject and category. With the embedding model, it also reads the text of the few notes closest to your question.
chat_suggestion_week: What did I write about this week?
chat_suggestion_watched: Which movies and shows did I watch?
chat_suggestion_todo: What do I still need to do?
chat_send_title: Send (Enter). Shift+Enter for a new line.
editor_description: Changing the subject or category takes the note over: the model will not relabel it.
editor_empty: A note cannot be empty. Delete it instead.
editor_uncategorised_hint: Click the selected one again to leave the note uncategorised.
spaces_trash_hint: Its folder is moved to {trash}. Move it back under {spaces} to restore it.
settings_general_description: The app's version and updates, where your notes live and how you capture them.
settings_root_hint: One markdown file per day lives here.
settings_root_dialog: Choose where to store your notes
settings_restart_needed: Saved. Restart Scratchnote to switch from {path}.
settings_hotkey_hint: Opens the capture window from anywhere.
settings_hide_on: The capture window closes as soon as a note is saved.
settings_hide_off: The capture window shows "Saved" for a second first.
settings_login_hint: Start Scratchnote when you sign in.
settings_onboarding_hint: Go through the first-run setup again: language, folder, shortcut, model and appearance.
settings_appearance_description: Language, colors and sizes. Changes apply right away.
settings_font_hint: The typeface of the interface and your notes.
settings_text_size_hint: Scales the whole interface, notes included.
settings_radius_hint: How rounded cards, buttons and inputs are.
settings_model_description: The local model that labels and enriches your notes.
settings_model_enabled_hint: Turn it off on a machine too small to run it. Notes are then saved but not labelled, and chat is unavailable.
settings_model_custom_missing: The custom file is missing, so notes stay pending.
settings_model_none: No model installed. Notes stay pending until one is.
settings_embedding_hint: Lets the chat find the notes that matter in a large space and read their text.
settings_gpu_none: No supported GPU found, so the model runs on the CPU.
settings_gpu_found: {devices}. Much faster and lighter on the CPU.
settings_idle_hint: Frees its memory; the next note loads it again. 0 keeps it loaded.
settings_benchmark_hint: Time how long this model takes to label a note on this machine.
settings_benchmark_busy: Notes are being labelled right now. Run it again once they are done.
settings_benchmark_failed: None of the sample notes could be labelled.
settings_benchmark_gpu: Slow on the CPU: turning on GPU acceleration should help.
settings_benchmark_light: Slow for this machine: the {light} model is smaller and should be about twice as fast.
settings_benchmark_slow: Slow for this machine. Notes are still labelled in the background, just later. On a machine this small, you can also turn the model off.
settings_index_description: The search index is only a cache of your markdown files. Each space has its own; these act on the open one.
settings_startup_description: How long this window took to open, from when it began loading until its first view was up. The first view waits for the plugins to load.
settings_rebuild_hint: Reparse every daily file. Always safe to run.

match.countPlural=one: Index rebuilt from the markdown: {count} note.
match.countPlural=other: Index rebuilt from the markdown: {count} notes.

settings_regenerate_hint: Clears the subject and category of every note in the open space, hand edits included, then runs the model again on each one. This cannot be undone, and it takes a while on a large journal.

match.countPlural=one: {count} note queued. The model works through it in the background.
match.countPlural=other: {count} notes queued. The model works through them in the background.

pages_none: No pages in this space yet.
pages_missing: Page not found. Its file may have been moved or deleted, or not synced yet.
pages_body_placeholder: Write here. It saves as you type.
pages_needs_title: Add a title to save this page.
pages_turn_into_description: The note gets a file of its own and shows on its day as a page.
move_description: It leaves {space} for the space picked and keeps its day, its category and its attachments.
pages_delete_description: Its file is deleted and it leaves its day. There is no undo.
pages_remove_stub_description: Only its link leaves the day. If its file turns up, the page comes back.
tasks_none: No open tasks. Start a line with - [ ] in a note or a page to add one.
settings_core_plugins_description: Features that ship with the app. Switch on the ones you want, off the ones you do not use.
settings_community_plugins_description: Features written by other people, added from the community list.
plugins_community_hint: Plugins written by other people. While this is off, none of their code runs.
plugins_browse_hint: Find plugins in the community list and install them.
plugins_updates_none: Every plugin is up to date.
plugins_installed_none: No community plugin is installed. Browse the list to find one.
plugins_uninstall_description: Its files and its settings are removed from the notes folder.
plugins_trust_description: A community plugin is code written by someone else, and it runs with the app's own access: it can read and change your notes, reach the internet, and run programs on this computer. Only install plugins whose authors you trust.
plugins_page_missing: This page belongs to a plugin that is switched off.
plugins_error_no_class: main.js does not export a Plugin class.
plugins_error_core_id: Has the id of a core plugin
tasks_description: Boxes to tick in notes and pages, the checklist button, and every open task on one page.
tasks_setting_ribbon_hint: Opens the open tasks, from any view.
tasks_setting_order_hint: Which tasks the list starts with.
basics_plugin_description: Tasks to tick and text to highlight, each with its own switch in the settings.
highlights_description: Text between ==double equals== on a band of color, from the toolbar or with Ctrl+Shift+H.
highlights_setting_color_hint: What highlighted text is painted with.
mentions_plugin_description: Write @name to mention someone. A click on a mention lists every note that names them.
mentions_none: No mentions yet. Write @name in a note.
stats_plugin_description: A panel beside the day with how much the space holds, your writing streak, and a heatmap of the days you wrote.
stats_setting_weeks_hint: How far back the heatmap goes.
journal_plugin_description: Your days as a journal book. Turn the pages from one day to the next, with the pictures of your notes taped in.
journal_empty: Nothing written yet. Your notes will fill these pages.
